handoff.title: Handoff and assignment
handoff.hint: Used when a bot, a flow or a teammate hands a conversation to this team.
handoff.methodHint: Manual: the conversation waits in the team's queue until someone claims it. Round robin and Least loaded pick a member for you and need a plan with assignment rules.
handoff.defaultAssigneeHint: Takes the conversation when nobody else can. Pick one of the team's members.
handoff.hoursHint: Off means always open. Outside these hours a conversation still waits in the queue and the contact gets the out-of-hours message of the flow.
handoff.hoursProblem: Each open day needs an opening and a closing time that differ.
